security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Clean your Downloads folder safely, offline.
bundle.longDescription: tidydrop sorts a messy Downloads folder into sensible folders using smart rules and an optional local AI model. It never deletes anything, always shows a preview, and can undo every cleanup.
